text:
Sara: Heads-up — NewHorizon POC hitting slow TTFT in hosted env and they just pinged pricing/security. Can we swarm? @Alex can you grab logs and initial metrics?

Alex: On it. Root cause candidates: 429s on some endpoints, high queueing on a shard, and KV cache miss spike. Need a requestId or session id to nail it.

Jin: Quick Q — is prefill enabled for this workspace? Prefill + batch_affinity can cause small queues if concurrency mismatch.

Sara: I think SE enabled prefill by default for smoother demos. Marta — did you toggle anything?

Marta: Yes we turned on prefill and left batch_affinity=auto. Also asked NewHorizon for their security questionnaire (KMS/PCI) and they asked about dedicated pricing tiers.

Alex: Pasting filtered logs for one requestId (redacted):

```
[2026-02-18T15:12:04Z] req=abcd1234 route=/v1/generate queue_ms=420 batch_size=8 kv_cache_hit=false
[2026-02-18T15:12:05Z] req=abcd1234 attempt=1 429 rate_limit exceeded pool=shard-3
[2026-02-18T15:12:05Z] req=abcd1234 final start_token_ms=1180 first_byte_ms=1550
```

Alex: KV cache miss rate ~74% for last 10m, TTFT p50 ~650ms but p95 ~1.6s.

ops-bot: autoscaler: shard-3 added +1 GPU at 15:13:08 due to queue depth > 80% (action: scale_up).

Jin: Two quick mitigations to try now: 1) temporarily disable batch_affinity or set batch_affinity=per-request so prefill doesn't force grouping; 2) increase prefill concurrency if you want prefill but more workers to warm KV. Either reduces queueing/429s.

Marta: For the customer-facing note: we should explain these are config knobs we can change in <30m, and that Dedicated gives predictable throughput if they want SLOs. Also sending pricing tiers now.

Sara: Can you give me exact commands/snippets I can paste in the thread with NewHorizon? They want step-by-step.

Alex: Paste these: 

```bash
# set temporary per-request batching to avoid affinity grouping
redwoodctl config set --workspace newhorizon --route /v1/generate batch_affinity=per-request
# toggle prefill concurrency (raise to 6)
redwoodctl config set --workspace newhorizon --prefill.concurrency 6
# watch KV miss rate
redwoodctl metrics query --workspace newhorizon "kv_cache_miss_rate[5m]"
```

Alex: After changes, expect p95 TTFT to drop within 1-2 mins if KV warming works. If 429s persist, we'll throttle their client or move them to dedicated pool for the demo.

security-team: Quick answer for the questionnaire draft: hosted uses managed keys by default (AES), we offer customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private. We'll send exact language in 1h.

Jin: Also FYI — if they plan bursty fanouts, recommend pre-warm script: run 20 parallel warmup calls with their typical prompt shape for 2 minutes before demos. That fixes most KV-miss-driven TTFT spikes.

Sara: Perfect. I'll send the commands + short explainer and loop in security-team for the questionnaire. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Marta: I'll also include pricing options for reserved capacity and a note about SLA differences.

Alex: I'll keep monitoring logs and will post an update in ~15m.
